description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy and directional/mechanical correctness of the norberts_gambit reference skill.

evals.prompt: How do I convert CAD to USD without paying my broker's FX spread?
evals.pass_condition: Agent invokes norberts_gambit and explains the DLR.TO/DLR.U journal mechanism rather than suggesting a bank wire or the broker's built-in conversion

evals.prompt: I have USD cash and need CAD out of my account — what do I buy first?
evals.pass_condition: Agent correctly states: buy DLR.U (matches the currency currently held), then journal to DLR.TO, then sell/withdraw as CAD — per the skill's direction table. Does not reverse the order.

evals.prompt: I have CAD and want USD, so I'll buy DLR.U first and then journal it to DLR.TO, right?
evals.pass_condition: Agent corrects the user per the documented 'Common Failures' section: buy the unit denominated in the currency you currently hold (DLR.TO, since they hold CAD), then journal to DLR.U — not the reverse. Explicitly flags that buying DLR.U first would require USD cash they don't have.

evals.prompt: Walk me through Norbert's Gambit for my Wealthsimple account
evals.setup: No references/wealthsimple.md file exists — only references/questrade.md is documented
evals.pass_condition: Agent states plainly that no reference file exists yet for Wealthsimple and offers to draft one from user-supplied details, rather than fabricating Wealthsimple-specific menu paths, fees, or processing times it has no source for.

evals.prompt: I need to sell some PSU-U.TO to free up cash to fund a buy in the same account
evals.pass_condition: Agent does not route this to norberts_gambit. Same-account capital sourcing (selling PSU-U.TO to fund a same-currency buy) is a different concern from cross-currency conversion via DLR.TO/DLR.U — norberts_gambit is specifically for CAD<->USD conversion, not intra-account capital reallocation.

benchmark_targets.directional_correctness: 100% of EVAL-002/003 pass (never reverses which symbol to buy first)
benchmark_targets.no_fabrication: 100% of EVAL-004 pass (no invented broker-specific steps for undocumented brokers)
